lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.43 - A Listen and number

details: Listen and number checks students' recall of the target vocabulary from Units 7 and 8 (events, feelings, in the classroom and at home), and gives them the opportunity to practise listening for detail.
Look for careful listening, accurate identification of the target vocabulary, and correct numbering of the boxes.

“This week was very busy! I played football and I’ve finished my homework! What about you? I hope you had fun! Can you see what the children in the photos did? Let’s listen and find out how their week has been! I hope they had fun too!”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

details: Listen and choose reviews the target language and key structures from Units 7 and 8 and offers a further opportunity to practise listening for detail.
Look for careful listening, accurate identification of the pictures based on the descriptions, and correct circling of the letters.

“Wow, they were busy! I’d love to know what these children were doing, but I’m not sure I can hear them clearly. What do you think they’ve been doing? Shall we listen and choose the correct pictures? Great!”

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.43 - C. Listen and write

details: Listen and write gives students another opportunity to practise their listening skills, think about appropriate answers to the questions based on the pictures, and practise using the key structures and target language to form complete sentences.

Look for careful listening, accurate identification of the pictures, correct word choice and word order, appropriate tense, correct spelling, a full stop at the end of the sentences, and neat writing on the lines.

“Good job, you’re very good at listening to people answer questions about their weeks. I really need to write some of these answers down! What do you think? 
Can you help me by listening and writing the answers the children give?”

“Well done, we’ve practised a lot. But I still can’t read these sentences… there’s some words missing! How can we find the right words? That’s right! The pictures! Let’s complete the sentences. How fast can you do it?”

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.44 - D. Listen and read.

details: Listen and read allows students to review the key structures and target language from Units 7 and 8, learn some new words, and practise their literacy skills.
Look for careful listening, students following the text while they listen, and clear pronunciation, steady pacing, and correct identification of each word while they read.

“Do you think you are good students? You do? I think so too! What about your parents? How do they know what you do at school? That’s right! A mid-term report! Do you think this student has had a good or bad term? Let’s listen and read the report and find out.”

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.44 - E. Choose or write the correct answers. 10m]

details: Choose or write the correct answers checks students’ understanding of the text and gives them an opportunity to practise reading for understanding.
Look for correct circling/writing of the answers and the ability to identify where in the text they found the answers.
“Tommy’s teacher is very pleased with him this term! But what did he do again? He didn’t argue with a friend did he? Or forget to give a speech? I’m sure you can find the right answers!”

Heads Up (Reading): 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and help Ss to understand the text by asking questions, practicing skimming (reading for gist), scanning (reading for specific information) and detail (reading for comprehension). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down (Listen and Chant): 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together (Video Chant): 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4R
